view_method: All nine original native PNGs directly viewed during this task before drafting; no generated component candidates used as character references.

style_notes.title: Nightglass Courier
style_notes.display_style: Clean action manhwa; refined adult facial drawing, crisp silhouettes, limited soft modeling and selective cyan edge light.

style_notes.title: Sunbreak Lancer
style_notes.display_style: Warm outlined painting; lively expressive faces, warm dark contours, broad sunlit ochre/red/blue planes and restrained texture.

style_notes.title: Iron Orchard
style_notes.display_style: Textured painted action fantasy; sculptural adult faces, opaque brush planes, tactile rust/olive/denim/cream materials, firm selective edges.

style_notes.title: Floodline Detective
style_notes.display_style: Graphic brush-ink noir; enormous black/white masses, handsome expressive adult faces, energetic broken edges, restrained hot pink only.

style_notes.title: Red Current
style_notes.display_style: Black-and-white action manga with vermilion; precise muscular anatomy, fine directional hatching, fierce eyes and bold tapered contours.

style_notes.title: Cathedral Engine
style_notes.display_style: Copperplate engraving; dense curved directional hatching and controlled crosshatching sculpt faces, cloth and bronze, parchment/black/aged brass only.

style_notes.title: Hollow Cartographer
style_notes.display_style: Clear-line adventure; economical clean contours, warm expressive adult cartoon faces, terracotta/mint/cream/sky blue, sparse simple shadows.

style_notes.title: Soft Thunder
style_notes.display_style: Bold expressive animation illustration; thick varied outlines, confident adult face construction, exaggerated body rhythm and broad colorful modeled planes, turquoise/orange/green/cream.

style_notes.title: Black Petal
style_notes.display_style: Refined fashion-horror illustration; sophisticated near-realistic adult faces, thin selective contour, silky restrained modeling, decisive black/bone shapes, crimson and silver accents.

observed_appeal: Anchors combine attractive intentional face construction, expressive eyes, confident poses, clear costume masses and iconic weapon presence. Civilian occupations were not retained as the identity default. The new draft changes face/hair/body/costume/weapon rather than recoloring anchor people.
